description: This file defines a PHP class 'ContactsViewValidPortalUsername' that extends SugarView to handle AJAX requests for validating whether a portal username already exists in the contacts database. It primarily checks for the existence of a 'portal_name' parameter and outputs the count of matching contact records.

classes.name: ContactsViewValidPortalUsername
classes.description: A class extending SugarView, providing an AJAX handler method to validate the uniqueness of a portal username within contacts.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Overridden method that invokes display() to handle the request.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Handles the AJAX request to check if 'portal_name' exists in contacts, outputs the count.
